Cinder Strider (CV 18)

A tall, narrow fire elemental with ember-bright joints and smoke trailing from its shoulders. Its long limbs and hot surface make close pursuit dangerous.

Attributes: Brawn +1; Fortitude +1; Agility +2; Guile +0; Knowledge +0; Reason +0

HP: 18 · Speed: 7 · Size: 1 (medium) · Armor DR: 0*

Evasion: 1 Bane · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 0

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Fire (3)\ Immunities: Bleeding; Poisoned; Asleep

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Cinder lash

Heat crawls along the strike, or frost flowers across the skin where it passes.

Target: One creature within 2 squares. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: fire.

Weak defense: Burning 2. Standard defense: Burning 1.

Heated Hide

After an adjacent attacker deals HP damage with a non-free attack, apply Burning 1 to that attacker. Costs Reaction; no retaliation against a free attack. Summons lack this Reaction.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Healing: Elemental: magical HP healing applies; cannot swallow potions. Printed immunities only.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: Scorch marks climb walls too high for an ordinary torch.

Purpose: Carry fire from a dying vent to a new opening.

Tactics and retreat: Touch clustered foes and use Heated Hide if struck in melee.

Counterplay and conversation: Clear combustible cover and keep it away from the settlement’s fuel.

Habitat: Volcano; forge ruin · Communication: None

Loot: A route to a volcanic deposit, not harvestable free flame.

Summoning: Elemental 3 — @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.da-rules.JournalEntry.5775e60cce058531.JournalEntryPage.5a9227bfa0cf0c92]{player reference}.
